race.title: Colin Baldwin Memorial Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: Hat-trick-seeking CENTURION'S SISTER could still be ahead of her mark and is taken to defy a rise in grade. Roarin' Success and Filibustering both look solid dangers in a tight handicap. CENTURION'S SISTER (IRE) ROARIN' SUCCESS FILIBUSTERING
race.bettingForecast: Filibustering (13/8), Centurion's Sister (2/1), Roarin' Success (9/2), Down To Business (13/2), Needs Must (12/1)
